chapter: Return to Atlanta and move north
title: Back in Atlanta while his mother is ill
summary: Green returns to his grandmother, does not know his mother is very sick, and resumes selling papers, dancing for coins and delivering for Dixie Drug Store.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And see, my mother was very sick at this time. I didn't know this. Maybe Ella B. Moore knew, see, but they wouldn't tell us. So one day I finally got home, got to Atlanta, Georgia, and my mother's mother was there in the house, and she would say, now, Boodjie, where did you come from? What happened? You know, so I explained to her about what the woman was doing. And my mother's mother was telling me, yeah, yeah, she was mean. She's a mean woman, and we

shouldn't have let you go away with them, see, you know. Glad to see you. Your mother'll be pleased, you know, and this, that and the other, but she wouldn't tell me that actually my mother was very sick, see.

And my mother used to go over to a place called Summer Hill. That's on the west side in Atlanta, Georgia. So finally mother come home, you know. I used to meet her at the streetcar, you know, stop there on Hilliard Street, going towards Highland Boulevard, you know. She was glad to see me and all, you know, but my mother wasn't well.

Now, adults have a way of covering up, you know. They don't let you know -- a little child know how bad off they are, see, and I think mother was on the way of dying, but I didn't know. So we got to be buddy-buddy again, so forth, and I stayed home there, stayed in Atlanta until -- I got my job back selling newspapers and dancing on the streets for coins, you know, and make me a little money somehow.
I was working for Taylor's -- Dr. Taylor's in the Dixie Drug Store. That's the job I got, you know, like running errands, delivering prescriptions for old folks and sick people like that. And --
Well, I was going on nine years old then.
